notes: 1908 single house at the Filbert corner, sage grey-green wood shingle with bottle-green trim over a low red-brown brick basement band. Upper-floor cant bay on brackets at the north half, single tall window at the south half, deep bracketed eaves under a hipped roof. Ground: stair up to a porch entry at the south end, a shuttered main-floor window and a corner window at the north. Filbert flank (edge 2) gets windows. Data gives 3 storeys, so the attic storey shows as a third window row. The shingle wall read warm tan and the brick band salmon; wall tint cooled to sage green, brick darkened to red-brown, entry cut down to door height. The main-floor windows now sit on a brick sill panel instead of shop glazing with pink panels, the entry is a narrow dark green door at the real-left stoop end, no garage-like opening; a small hipped dormer block sits on the roof over the centre; trim pushed to a deeper forest green. The data gives 3 storeys, so an attic window row remains where the real house has its roof; a porch hood and paired eave brackets have no style key. Main-floor lights raised to a 1.75 m sill over a shingled panel so the glazing reads as a raised house window rather than shop glazing; transom thinned. The three data storeys become a 2.6 m street level (a 1.1 m red-brown brick plinth, shingle above, the entry at the real-left end reached by pale stone stoop bands under a small dark green hood), a main floor with a shallow flat cant bay, and an upper floor with a deeper dark-green-framed cant bay; the walls stop at 8.7 m (wallTopM) under deep bracketed eaves, and a steep hipped roof over the whole footprint plus a tall dormer block over the centre fill the LiDAR height instead of a flat-roof box; wall darker grey-green, trim dark green. The two street-level lights under the bays are removed; the basement face is brick plinth and shingle with only the stoop entry. Applied: grey-olive wall 7a806f (no shingle material in the kit, siding used), forest-green trim 2f4536, oriel on storey 2 only, storey-1 flat window (shutters not drawn) instead of the shallow bay plus a small canted corner bay at the right, 10-step stair with brick cheek walls. Gabled porch hood and gabled belvedere windows have no key (hip block only). Mirrored claim SKIPPED. Applied: shingle grey-olive 737566, forest green 2c3b31, brick plinth 0.6 m 8a4a38, oriel centred 0.75, deeper eaves. Gabled porch hood and dormer have no key. Applied: shingle relief on the walls (hyDShingle), near-black green trim, deeper 0.7 m eaves, deeper porch hood, taller brick band 1.0 m. Wall tint kept 737566. Hand pass 1 (2026-10-02): the roll's 3 storeys are basement + main + upper: floorsM 1.6/3.05 puts the bay on the upper floor under the eave; brick basement to 1.6 m; entry, porch gable, stair and window hood moved to hand.py. Hand pass 1b: basement is one blank brick run (an empty layout drew default shop panels); main roof block hip rise 4.1 m so the hip springs from the eave (the 3.8 m rise left a 1.3 m plain band above the cornice). Tint lift (2026-10-02): wall tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k).
